# Artgor Cube555 TPU source snapshot

These files are an exact snapshot of Andrey Lukyanenko's (`artgor`) public
Kaggle notebook [CayleyPy cube555 TPU beam
Q](https://www.kaggle.com/code/artgor/cayleypy-cube555-tpu-beam-q/notebook?scriptVersionId=344319112),
script version `344319112`.

TPUBeamSearch keeps this immutable snapshot only to build, attribute, and
validate the requested derivative notebook against a fixed upstream source.
The snapshot does not replace the upstream page and does not assign a new
license to Artgor's work. The accelerated TPUBeamSearch implementation is kept
separately under `src/tpu_beam_search/`.
